description: Input: the same fields as quote_faceless, plus attempt. Start a faceless video from a script or brief: an opening clip and image scenes. You select 30–90 seconds; it ends with its narration, at least 25 seconds and at most a quarter past the selection, never beyond 90. Captions are on unless turned off. Poll get_run. attempt=2,3,… starts a new run. Price: generated picture 7 credits per image plus opening clip 49 credits per clip plus production (story, voice and render) 1 credits per second of video plus action shot 30 credits per second of clip plus music under the voice 60 credits per music track in the video, at least 50. Quote first with quote_faceless.
name: make_faceless
title: Make a faceless video
